command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek properly withholds a command; the Master payload is not an executable sequence because record context, fragment boundaries and Sensor Type remain unresolved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: None until a vendor/firmware-approved Partial Add sequence and assembled-record oracle exist.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The raw command, placeholder, script and timing remain unchanged as evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define a versioned fragment-state machine, preserve capacity/baseline, obtain exact-sequence approval, issue fragments once, correlate the assembled record and retain evidence without clearing history.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Does not guess that a single record-shaped payload is a valid Partial Add transaction.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Ordinary Add SEL or read-only listing cannot substitute for fragment/assembly coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A malformed/incomplete sequence can leave misleading or corrupt fault records and trigger consumers.

project_override_considerations: A vendor tool can replace raw transport only if it demonstrably exercises the same partial-fragment protocol and exposes sequence/assembly evidence; high-level ordinary add is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Approved protocol revision and exact fragments
Assembled returned record ID and decoded readback

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master labels a partial operation but shows one unexplained record-shaped command, leaves Sensor Type open, clears the SEL and uses transport-only Criteria. DeepSeek supplies no executable contract, confirming that core semantics are absent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Fragment ordering, record context and completion behavior define the function itself and cannot be treated as ordinary Project values or safely inferred from Add SEL.

review_improvement: Keeps the functional write objective while preventing guessed fragment traffic and requiring assembled-record proof and recovery boundaries.
independent_technical_reasoning: Partial Add is a stateful write protocol, not simply Add SEL with another command code. Without an authoritative state machine and exact fragments, any run could corrupt audit history, so BLOCKED is required.

source_provenance.history: Ordinary Add/adjacent SEL cases and prior review searched
